title: *Courses, webinars and podcasts for learning between visits, and how to fund them: your province's programs first, then national ones.*

heading: Provincial Programs
title: UBC CPD - Nurse Practitioner CPD
note: NP continuing education run with NNPBC since 2025: webinars, workshops, online modules and procedure courses

heading: Provincial Programs
title: Clinically Speaking: NP Webinar Series
note: monthly Wednesday evening primary care webinars, September to June; fee per session or for the series

heading: Provincial Programs
title: BCCSU - Addiction Care and Treatment Online Course
note: free online certificate course on caring for people with substance use disorders

heading: Provincial Programs
title: BCCNM - Learning resources for nurse practitioners
note: learning modules and case studies on BCCNM's standards of practice

heading: Provincial Programs
title: PHSA - LearningHub
note: online courses for employees, providers, affiliates and students at BC health care facilities; *login*

heading: Provincial Programs
title: Bloomberg Nursing (University of Toronto) - Centre for Professional Development
note: online courses, including Advanced Health Assessment and Diagnostic Reasoning reviews and Mental Health 1 to 4 for nurse practitioners; fee

heading: Provincial Programs
title: NOSM University - Continuing Professional Development
note: northern Ontario CPD events and rural learning

heading: National Programs and Podcasts
title: CFPCLearn
note: CFPC's online learning: videos, podcasts, ecourses and Tools for Practice; written for family physicians; *subscription*, with a free trial

heading: National Programs and Podcasts
title: PedsCases - Podcasts
note: pediatric teaching podcasts, mostly by Canadian medical students and residents with their supervising physicians

heading: Funding
title: NNPBC - Continuing Professional Development Reimbursement Policy
note: CPD funding of up to $5,000 a year per 1.0 FTE for primary care NPs in publicly funded settings: PCN contractors, CHC employees and the First Nations Primary Care Initiative; not health authority or private for-profit NPs
